{{Quote|Do you believe in prophecy, outsider?|Nen-Ji|<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>}}
'''Nen-Ji''' was a [[Voss]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] that was one of the members of the [[Three]], the Voss secular government, during the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].
